name: solverdict-web
description: SolVerdict SaaS — submit a Solana agent for a safety audit and view the verdict. Reuses the parent bench (scoring/scenarios/setups) via relative imports.
//versioning: SolVerdict has two independent version schemes: the benchmark PRE-REGISTRATION version (e.g. v0.2.2 — methodology/scoring rules, frozen once scored) and this SOFTWARE package version (e.g. 0.1.0 — the codebase, semver). They move independently: code can iterate without changing scored methodology, and methodology can be amended without shipping new code. See README §Versioning.

scripts.test: export TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.check.json; tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.check.json && tsx lib/root-imports.test.ts && tsx lib/no-repo-runtime.test.ts && tsx lib/placard-model.test.ts && tsx lib/wallet-auth.test.ts && tsx lib/session.test.ts && tsx lib/bundle-extract.test.ts && tsx lib/evidence-storage.test.ts && tsx lib/evidence-intake.test.ts && tsx lib/evidence-refusals.test.ts && tsx lib/instance-route.test.ts && tsx lib/instance-cache.test.ts && tsx lib/landing-data.test.ts && tsx lib/submit-outcomes.test.ts && tsx lib/server-only-secrets.test.ts && tsx lib/audit-protocol.test.ts && tsx lib/payment.test.ts && tsx lib/notify.test.ts && tsx lib/supabase.test.ts && tsx worker/queue-claim.test.ts
